propositions: The reconciler core currently reaches into the Jira adapter directly with no named interface a second backend could implement.
Introduce a Backend facade with five role Protocols, three @runtime_checkable opt-in capability Protocols, and a RemoteRef{vendor,instance,remote_id} identity dataclass.
Capabilities are detected via isinstance checks against the opt-in Protocols rather than a capabilities() method or structural attribute introspection.
JiraBackend is a thin delegation wrapper over existing Jira modules with zero behavior change.
IdentityConvention is a new pure convention object that formats a RemoteRef to a rebar-id:{remote_id} label and parses it back, centralizing a format currently inlined at four core call sites.
A backend-agnostic parameterized contract suite runs against both JiraBackend (injected mock transport) and an in-memory FakeBackend, with characterization tests pinning exact current mapper outputs.
